scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w backend && npm run test:coverage -w frontend
scripts.db:reset: node bin/container.mjs compose down -v && node bin/container.mjs compose up -d db && sleep 3 && npm run db:migrate -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
scripts.app:reset: node bin/container.mjs compose -f docker-compose.app.yml down -v && node bin/container.mjs compose -f docker-compose.app.yml up --build
